name: rf_protoboard
description: Real 2-layer RF prototype board, native KiCad source (KiCad 7, file version 20221018). First KiCad board and first non-Gerber (native-rendered) entry in the corpus.
notes: Exercises the native KiCad ingestion path (kicad-cli absent -> gerbonara renderer): geometry_source is the native render, not the user's own Gerbers, so this answers 'is this design manufacturable' rather than 'is this fabrication package correct'. IMPORTANT: because the geometry is rendered by gerbonara rather than read from fixed Gerber files, this board's baseline depends on the gerbonara version and is less stable than the Gerber-input boards (see #27, which also tracks native-KiCad parser fragility -- 3 of 4 trial boards failed to parse; this KiCad-7 board is the one that works). The native render produces filled copper regions rather than trace segments, so the trace-centric checks (min_trace_width, min_trace_spacing, mask_to_trace_clearance) report not_applicable here; that is a property of the render path, not asserted as an invariant. No checks fail on this board; the overall verdict is not pinned.
